notes: Corrected: the frame's that (t014) moves from the second הָיָה to the apodosis waw s018, which is no longer `unrepresented`. Rule 45 keys the disposition to the Hebrew — apodosis waw present, that waw takes the word — and v.35 in this same chapter applies that case, while v.11 applies the asyndetic case.
what good soever ... the same distributes over four morphemes: the two articles take what and the, the adjective takes good, the relative takes soever, and הוּא takes same.
Unlike v.29's do thee good, neither Hiphil here is headed on a complement, since good is written for the adjective הַטּוֹב rather than for the verb.
